narrative.overview:
ksamods.gg reads like a well-kept catalogue: warm off-white paper, near-black ink, white cards drawn with a single hairline, and nothing decorative between the reader and the mods. The only imagery is the mods' own icons (and member avatars); every other surface is type, hairline and a little warm grey. The system is light by default and follows the operating system into a near-black dark mode where every value has a hand-picked twin.

Density is moderate and list-like. Pages are built from cards on a 72rem column, with small type (14px body is the working size) and generous vertical gaps between sections. Hierarchy comes from weight and size inside one family, not from colour. The red-orange accent is rare and means something: today's node on the release rail, the unread badge, the "Mod loader" marker, errors, link hover, focus and selection.
keyCharacteristics: Two grounds, two card surfaces, one ink, one muted grey, each with an explicit dark twin.
Hairline inset borders instead of drop shadows; lift shadows only on floating layers.
One typeface (Instrument Sans) at weights 400/500/600, tight tracking on headings.
Accent used for state and signal, never for fills of large areas.
Mod icons are the only pictures.

rules.name: The Twin Rule
rules.body: Every colour is written as a light/dark pair in the same class string. A value without its dark twin is a bug.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Red marks state or attention (today, unread, error, hover, focus). It never fills a button, a card or a section background.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: Labels and headings are sentence case at normal tracking; there is no uppercase micro-label tier in this system.

rules.name: The Tabular Count Rule
rules.body: Counts, download numbers, versions and step numbers use tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Drawn-Not-Cast Rule
rules.body: Surfaces on the page get a hairline, never a drop shadow. Only something floating over other content casts one.

dos: Do write every colour as a light/dark pair (for example ink #1b1b18 with #EDEDEC, card #fff with #161615).
Do draw card edges with the inset hairline (rgba(26,26,0,0.16) / #fffaed2d) and darken it on hover.
Do keep body UI at 14px and metadata at 12px muted, with tabular numerals for counts and versions.
Do use mod icons, with the Warm Fill initial-letter placeholder when a mod has none, as the only imagery.
Do keep Signal Red to state and signal: today, unread, errors, link hover, focus, selection.
Do inline stroked SVG for icons (as the bell and star do).
donts: Don't fill buttons, cards or sections with Signal Red; primary actions are ink.
Don't add drop shadows to resting cards; reserve the Float shadow for menus and toasts.
Don't introduce a second typeface or uppercase tracked labels.
Don't add stock photography, illustration or gradient decoration; the mods' own icons carry the imagery.
Don't use unicode arrows or emoji as icons.
